propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Praesta, quaesumus, Domine: ut, sicut populus christianus Martyrum tuorum
Felicis, Simplicii, Faustini et Beatricis temporali solemnitate congaudet,
ita perfruatur aeterna; et, quod votis celebrat, comprehendat effectu. Per
Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Historical source comm-ss-felicis-simplicii-faustini-beatricis/main/Collect/all/1; strict. Complete Latin word sequence and actual ending equal under typography only. Original target proof passage.catholic-church.missale-romanum.vatican-typica-1962.temporal-comm-ss-felicis-simplicii-faustini-beatricis-orations retained. No source-recipient calendar attestation or official 1962 English claimed.

translations.text: Grant, we beseech Thee, O Lord, that, as Thy Christian people joyfully unite in celebrating the temporal solemnity of Thy holy martyrs Felix, Simplicius, Faustinus, and Beatrice, so they may enjoy it in eternity, and may effectually attain to what they celebrate in desire. Through our Lord.
